_comment: STAGE-D per-batch coverage registry (carrier batch) for the full-coverage program
(docs/SIMULATOR.md SS12.3/12.4). Same AST-derived,
anti-stale schema as tests/_support/stage_d_coverage_targets.json (D1). Run via
tests/harness/gate.py <this file> (L0+L1; calls tests/harness/coverage_audit.py) and
tests/harness/mutation.py <this file> (L2).
MODULE: quantum_bath/carrier.py -- the dual-ancilla dual-axis EXACT-DM carrier for the
shared-bath (pseudomode) simulator (9 CPU-pure public units: 4-qubit parity gates + an
exact reduced-idle GKSL apply + ancilla-mediated instruments + the exact 3-round
dual-axis record points and their QRT/reduced-map null). Pure numpy/math/scipy
(device-agnostic; no torch, no quimb, no cuda) -- EVERYTHING is in scope; out_of_scope
is EMPTY (a CPU-pure module cannot park a unit as gpu_bound/quimb_bound: the audit's
_module_imports check would structurally refute it).
NO EXEMPTIONS. Every public unit reaches 100% statement + 100% branch. Branch surface:
cnot4 has a real for-loop + `if bits[control]==1` (BOTH arcs covered by one 16-state
call); dual_extract / quantum_dual_P_all / quantum_dual_P_all_qrt have real for-loops
(enter+exit arcs covered by one call). The other five units are straight-line OR carry
only a bare `assert` (dual_point/dual_point_qrt) -- coverage.py emits NO branch arc for
a bare assert (verified empirically), so those score branch 0/0 (nothing to miss). The
assert's False arc is a raise unreachable with valid inputs (norm==1 is a
trace-preservation theorem of the instrument) AND carries no coverage obligation -- so
no defensive-assert exemption is needed (D1 finding-2 probed: the underflow/invalid
probe is moot because there is no tracked arc to reach).

units.note: The `assert abs(norm-1.0)<1e-8` is a plain covered statement on every passing call; coverage.py models no branch arc for a bare assert, so dual_point scores branch 0/0 with NO exemption. The assert's False arc (norm!=1) is unreachable with valid inputs (norm==1 is a trace-preservation theorem of the projected+reset instrument) -- and there is no tracked arc to reach anyway. test_KILLER_dual_point_norm_would_fail_for_dropped_leaf_variant shows the assert is not vacuous.
Same as dual_point: bare `assert` => branch 0/0, no exemption; the False arc is a trace-preservation-guaranteed unreachable raise with no tracked coverage obligation.
